text:
We're a small team, and we recently moved our CI to a new provider. Nobody planned a big announcement. It was just a thing that needed doing, so we did it between everything else.

The part I keep thinking about is when the buildbot dashboard came up. It was one of those moments where something you'd stopped paying attention to suddenly needs a decision. Do we carry it over, rebuild it, or let it go? On a small team, that question lands on a few people, and there's no committee to hand it to.

That's probably the main thing I took from the whole move. A migration is less about the new tool than about everything the old setup was quietly doing for you. You only find that out by moving, and it's easier to find out when the team is small enough to sit down and talk it through.

If you've moved CI before, what's the one thing the old setup was doing that you didn't realize until it was gone?
